about_the_game:
A newly reborn tale of sound, woven around Mana and Seiken.

Secret of Mana retains the nostalgic atmosphere of its 1993 release but has been reimagined with fully refreshed visuals.

All tracks have been newly arranged under the supervision of the composor Hiroki Kikuta.

This version blends the charm of its original sound with modern expressions, offering a captivating experience for both longtime fans and newcomers.

Over 10 arrangers, all devoted admirers of the classic, have poured their love into these tracks, allowing listeners to truly feel their passion.

*This information is based on the CD release in February 2018.
